# CodexMeter 2.0.2
Small notch additions.
## What changed
- **Local Ollama models.** When `ollama serve` is running, the notch shows a cell with how many models are loaded, and the tooltip lists them by name and resident memory. It is not a ring — a local model server has no quota. No daemon, or nothing loaded, means no cell. - **Limit-alert mute is per provider.** The 80% / 100% notification can now be muted for any of the notch's ten quota providers, not just Codex and Claude — see **Settings ▸ Notch ▸ Limit Alerts**.
## Verification
- 592 automated tests, 0 failures (9 environment-integration tests skipped). - `swift build` with zero warnings and zero errors. - Universal 2 build for Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later. - Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. SHA-256 protects the first download; Sparkle authenticates later updates with Ed25519 signatures.
## Install or update with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask --greedy dlfkdLR/tap/codexmeter ```
```bash xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
## First direct-download launch
Download `CodexMeter-2.0.2.dmg` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` into the same folder and verify the checksum before opening:
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-2.0.2.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - open CodexMeter-2.0.2.dmg ```
## Recovery
This release does not migrate any database. Published version tags are immutable; corrections ship as a new patch release.
